title: Harborline GAP Waiver Premier 150 Deductible Reimbursement Schedule
content:
**Schedule: GAP Waiver Addenda, GAP Waiver Premier 150.** The Harborline GAP Waiver Premier 150 deductible reimbursement schedule sets the reimbursement maximum for the Premier deductible reimbursement. The maximum depends on the loss the claim shows.

| Loss the claim shows | Reimbursement maximum |
|---|---|
| collision total loss | the plan's deductible reimbursement maximum |
| unrecovered theft | 500.00 |
| comprehensive total loss | 250.00 |
| no loss type shown | 250.00 |

The Premier deductible reimbursement never exceeds the maximum the schedule sets for the claim's loss.

*Hypothetical cases.* A comprehensive total loss on which the insurer withheld 400.00 is reimbursed at most 250.00. An unrecovered theft on which the insurer withheld 350.00 is not limited by the schedule, since 350.00 is within its 500.00 maximum.
